parent_scope_objection: Final second and last review, preserving initial call. Independent source validator and parent read the primary source and raised these specific unresolved scientific questions. Address each from actual source: Scope objection: the original Study 1 had only an implicit measure; the explicit rating task was newly added in this replication, while the original Study 2 had both measures. Both original-study results are described as replicated. The authors call the new chromatic explicit test a failure, but that does not itself demonstrate disagreement with a previously reported original result under that added condition. Argon explicitly notices the addition but counts it as an original failure without resolving this distinction. The 3/4 count and general theory test do not settle the original-specific outcome; parent must resolve this against the successful original comparisons and overall strong/replicable conclusion.
